content: Embedding vectors from different model versions occupy different semantic spaces; mixing them (e.g. old migrated vectors alongside newly-generated ones) causes silent RAG/semantic-search degradation with no errors, only quietly wrong similarity rankings (cosine scores dropping from ~0.85 to ~0.65 is a diagnostic signal). Safe migration practice is to re-embed the full corpus with the new model as a distinct version before cutting over query-side embedding generation, never mixing model-version vectors in the same similarity comparison.
